{"metadata":{"description":"Full 2-way Telegram Remote Control, Vision, Voice, Shell, Diff & Sound Notifications for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)","id":"gh:1402946730","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-telegram-bridge","slug":"datit309/dsh-telegram-bridge","topics":["deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Full 2-way Telegram Remote Control, Vision, Voice, Shell, Diff & Sound Notifications for DeepSeek Ha"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"Telegram Remote Control, Vision, Voice, Shell, Diff & Sound Notifications for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-telegram-bridge"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | Tiếng Việt"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Full two-way Telegram remote control, real-time progress tracking, and native OS notifications for D"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"eepSeek Harness (DSH)."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Turn your phone into a remote coding cockpit for your local DSH agent: send text prompts, voice mess"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ages, screenshots, inspect live diffs, switch models/sessions, execute shell commands, approve tools"},{"id":"p5s3","text":", and download generated deliverables."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Key Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### 1. Two-Way Remote Control via Telegram
- 💬 **Remote Prompting**: Send any text message in Telegr"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"am; the active agent on your Mac receives and runs it immediately.
- 🎙 **Voice-to-Text**: Hold to re"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"cord a voice message (`.ogg`). The bot converts audio via `ffmpeg` + Gemini speech-to-text into a cl"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ean text prompt for the agent.
- 📷 **Vision / Screenshots**: Send terminal or UI bug screenshots wit"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"h optional captions; the agent parses the image and fixes the code.
- 📁 **Document Upload**: Send `."},{"id":"p7s6","text":"pdf`, `.sql`, `.json`, `.py`, `.js`, `.txt` files directly to your agent's workspace.
- ⚡ **Live Pro"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"gress Card**: Dynamically updates tool execution steps (`read`, `edit`, `bash`, `serena`, etc.) in a"},{"id":"p7s8","text":" single message with typing indicators, preventing notification spam.
- 🔘 **Post-Turn Action Bar**: "},{"id":"p7s9","text":"Every completed turn includes one-touch inline buttons: `[ 📄 View Diff ]`, `[ 📁 Modified Files ]`, `"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"[ 🚀 Git Status ]`, `[ 🔇 Mute/Unmute ]`, `[ 🔄 New Session ]`."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### 2. Source Code & System Management
- 📄 **Live Git Diff (`/diff`)**: View detailed staged and uns"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"taged code changes within the active workspace.
- 🚀 **Git Commit & Push (`/commit <message>`)**: Run"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" `git add -A && git commit -m <msg> && git push` directly from your phone.
- 💻 **Direct Shell Execut"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ion (`/sh <command>`)**: Run terminal commands (e.g. `git status`, `pnpm test`, `docker ps`, `pm2 st"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"atus`) locally with zero LLM token cost.
- 📥 **One-Touch File Download (`/get <file>`)**: Download f"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"iles from your host machine with one click in `/files` or via `/get <path>`.
- 🎁 **Deliverable Auto-"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"Delivery**: When the agent calls the `present` tool, generated deliverables are automatically upload"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"ed to your Telegram chat."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### 3. Session & Workspace Navigation
- 📋 **Session Switching (`/sessions`, `/switch <index>`)**: Li"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"st all open DSH sessions and switch active targets with inline buttons or indices.
- 📂 **Workspace S"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"witching (`/workspaces`, `/cd <path>`)**: Browse project directories and change working directories "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"on the fly.
- 🧠 **Model Switcher (`/model`)**: Switch between models (Gemini 3.8 Flash, Claude 4.6 S"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"onnet, GPT-6 Astra, etc.) via interactive inline buttons.
- 🔄 **New Session (`/new`)**: Spawn a fres"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"h session in the active workspace."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### 4. Interactive Permissions & Security
- 🛡 **Tool Approval Buttons**: When an agent requests elev"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ated permissions (`approval/asked`), the bot prompts with `[ ✅ Allow ]` and `[ ❌ Reject ]`.
- ❓ **Us"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"er Questions (`ask_user_question`)**: Interactive single/multi-choice buttons for agent questions.
-"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" 🔒 **Chat ID Locking**: Only authorized Telegram chat IDs can interact; unauthorized access receives"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"king**: Only authorized Telegram chat IDs can interact; unauthorized access receives a 403 response."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### 5. Native OS Audio & Desktop Notifications
- 🔊 **System Audio**: Native macOS audio alerts via `"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"afplay` (`Hero.aiff` on success, `Basso.aiff` on error, `Ping.aiff` on prompt/approval).
- 🔔 **Deskt"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"op Banners**: macOS Notification Center banners with project name, execution time, and modified file"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" list.
- 🔇 **Remote Mute (`/mute`, `/unmute`)**: Mute Mac speakers from your phone when you need sil"},{"id":"p11s5","text":".
- 🔇 **Remote Mute (`/mute`, `/unmute`)**: Mute Mac speakers from your phone when you need silence."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Telegram Command Reference"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Command | Description |
|:--- |:--- |
| **Send Voice Message** | Converts speech to text and dispa"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"tches as a prompt |
| **Send Photo + Caption** | Attaches screenshot for vision-based bug fixing |
|"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" **Send Document** | Uploads code or docs into workspace for analysis |
| `/diff` | Displays git dif"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"f for the active workspace |
| `/commit <msg>` | Commits and pushes changes to git remote |
| `/sh <"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"command>` | Runs shell commands directly on host (0 tokens) |
| `/get <file>` | Downloads file from "},{"id":"p13s6","text":"host machine to Telegram |
| `/files` | Lists recently modified files with 1-click download buttons "},{"id":"p13s7","text":"|
| `/workspaces` | Lists available workspaces with quick-switch buttons |
| `/cd <path>` | Changes "},{"id":"p13s8","text":"agent's working directory |
| `/model` | Opens interactive model selection menu |
| `/sessions` | Li"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"sts open sessions with quick-switch buttons |
| `/switch <index>` | Switches to session by index or "},{"id":"p13s10","text":"ID |
| `/mute` | Mutes Mac speaker sounds |
| `/unmute` | Unmutes Mac speaker sounds |
| `/new` | Sp"},{"id":"p13s11","text":"awns a new session |
| `/status` | Shows status of agent, session, workspace, and speaker |
| `/stop"},{"id":"p13s12","text":"` | Aborts current agent turn immediately |
| `/help` | Displays help message and command list |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Prerequisites"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"1. **Telegram Bot Token**: Created via @BotFather.
2. **Audio / Voice-to-Text (Optional)**:
- `ffmpe"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"g` installed on your host system (e.g. `brew install ffmpeg`).
- `BeeRouter` running locally on port"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" `20128` (or an OpenAI-compatible speech/chat endpoint) to transcribe incoming voice notes.
3. **Sec"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"urity & Chat ID Locking**:
- If `chatId` is left unconfigured, **the first sender to message the bot"},{"id":"p15s5","text":" will be automatically claimed and locked as the owner**.
- For public or shared bots, configure you"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"r `chatId` explicitly before starting the bot to prevent unauthorized claiming."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Installation Guide for DSH"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Option 1: Via DSH CLI (Recommended)"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Run the standard `dsh plugin add` command in your terminal:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Or install from a local checkout:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"> `dsh plugin add` automatically records the dependency in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` and ac"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"tivates the bundle layer in `dsh.profile.bundles`."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Option 2: Via DSH Web GUI"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"1. Open DeepSeek Harness Web GUI (`http://127.0.0.1:3080`).
2. Click the **Plugins icon (puzzle piec"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"e)** in the far-left sidebar.
3. Click **Add plugin** in the top-right corner.
4. Enter the GitHub r"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"epository specifier:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"5. Click **Install**. The plugin will be downloaded, bundled, and activated automatically."}],"truncated":true}
